name: Bulk RNA-seq limma-voom (Python)
description: limma-voom differential expression (TMM, voom weights, moderated t, empirical Bayes) in numpy/scipy, validated against R limma 3.68 / edgeR 4.10.

inputs.name: counts
inputs.format: genes x samples count matrix (integer or fractional)

inputs.name: samples
inputs.format: sample table with the design variables

outputs: per-gene coefficients, moderated t, p, BH q
